item.title: AI Weekly – July 14, 2025
item.description:
This week’s AI landscape spans major government bets, tech disruption, and regulatory evolution—marking a critical moment for AI’s future.

1. xAI & OpenAI Land $200 M DoD Contracts

Elon Musk’s xAI and OpenAI have each been awarded up to $200 million contracts by the U.S. Department of Defense to develop agentic AI tools across military, intelligence, and federal use cases. xAI’s “Grok for Government” suite, featuring its Grok 4 model, joins similar deals with Google and Anthropic :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}.
